items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I said to Harry Leroy, "How's it going, Harry?"

ctx.x: Running the car, I don't know whether he was jealous or what his story was, looked like a frame-up. I forget -- Gimp was his name. Gimp, that was Ruth Etting's husband.
But anyway we were coming downtown to do the show and we're downtown, I said to Harry Leroy, "How's it going, Harry?"

"Man, how do you do it?" "How do you do what," I says. He says, "How do you keep the audience still applauding for you like you did the opening night." I says, "I just have to keep on dancing, man, are you kidding." "You let up on yours, you got enough on opening night, huh? I didn't have enough." "I didn't get a good opening night. I had to follow everything on opening night, justlook what time I went on the stage?" I just gotta go keep on dancing and we were just as big after the opening as we were the opening.…
